t: There is hereby authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.

fable.w: This is a bare authorization of appropriations to carry out the Act. It involves no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government. There is no tempting participation reading, as no outside actor or decision process is mentioned.
fable.s: There is hereby authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.

qwen_block.w: This section is a standard authorization of appropriations clause. It merely provides the legal authority for Congress to allocate funds to execute the Act. It does not establish any mechanism for consultation, coordination, or input from outside parties (such as the public, states, or private entities) in the decision-making process.
qwen_block.s: There is hereby authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.

opus.w: This section only authorizes appropriations to carry out the Act. It does not involve anyone outside the federal government in any federal decision. Like Example 1, it is a funding provision with no participation process.
opus.s: There is hereby authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
opus.b: 1. **Thinking:** Nothing here is tempting. The section only authorizes funding to carry out the Act. It involves no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a standard authorization of appropriations clause. It provides funding for the Act but does not itself mandate or describe any process for public participation, consultation with outside entities, or advisory committees. It contains no procedural requirements for interaction with non-federal parties.
qwen_chat.s: There is hereby authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "carrying out the provisions of this Act" implicitly involves participation if other parts of the Act require it. However, this specific section is merely an authorization of appropriations (funding). It does not itself establish any process for consultation, comment, or coordination with outside parties. It is a standard boilerplate funding clause.
